name: manual_5d8808
claim: OpenClaw defaults single source of truth (operator, 2026-11-27): the owner is the Perpetua-Tools config as part of the AlphaClaw constellation; orama consumers resolve the live PT root first, then a generated byte-identical vendored copy, and fail closed only when neither exists; scripts emit patches by default and every change goes through the staged restore loop; the mac orchestrator json is generated from the data; the macOS AlphaClaw patches stay and must be idempotent no-ops in all versions; the Mac LM Studio manual-only stanza stays in the data file, disabled and in no chain.

decisions.notes: Operator answers to the six open questions of the OpenClaw defaults plan: owner PT, vendored copy before failing closed, emit-only by default, generate mac-orchestrator, keep the AlphaClaw macOS patches for idempotency, keep the manual-only stanza.

rationale: Operator answers to the six open questions of the OpenClaw defaults plan: owner PT, vendored copy before failing closed, emit-only by default, generate mac-orchestrator, keep the AlphaClaw macOS patches for idempotency, keep the manual-only stanza.
